question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"navigates"** means to plan and direct the route or course of a ship, aircraft, or other form of transportation, especially by using instruments or maps. (मार्गदर्शन करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The captain skillfully **navigates** the ship through the narrow channel.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the correct word for fill in the blanks no. 3 is **"navigates"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Customises **(अनुकूलित करना): To modify something to suit a particular individual or task.

 
 
• **Example:** She **customises **her car with unique decals and accessories.
 
 
 
• **Procures **(प्राप्त करना): To obtain something, especially with effort or difficulty.
 
 
• **Example: **He **procures** the rare books for his collection from various sources.
 
 
 
• **Coordinates** (समन्वय करना): To organize the different elements of a complex activity or organization so as to enable them to work together effectively.
 
 
• **Example:** She **coordinates **the schedules of all team members to ensure smooth project execution.
